userStories.title: Section-based cfg renderer
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a section-based renderer that produces valid xrpld.cfg output from nested input types.
acceptanceCriteria: Create packages/generator/src/renderers/cfg-renderer.ts
renderSingleValueSection(name, value) returns '[name]\nvalue' or empty string if undefined
renderKeyValueSection(name, pairs) returns '[name]\nkey=value' per line, omits undefined keys, empty string if no pairs
renderListSection(name, items) returns '[name]\nitem' per line, empty string if undefined/empty
renderPortSection(port: XrpldPortConfig) renders [port_name] with all provided keys as key = value lines
renderServerSection(ports) renders [server] listing all port names
renderXrpldCfg(config: XrpldInput) assembles full cfg: header comment, server+ports, node_db, all single-value sections, all list sections, all key-value sections — omitting empty sections

Renders all single-value sections: debug_logfile, database_path, ssl_verify, node_size, ledger_history, fetch_depth, peer_private, network_id, network_quorum, fee_default, workers, io_workers, prefetch_workers, sweep_interval, path_search, path_search_old, path_search_fast, path_search_max, peers_max, peers_in_max, peers_out_max, max_transactions, compression, signing_support, beta_rpc_api, ledger_replay, websocket_ping_frequency, server_domain, elb_support, amendment_majority_time, rpc_allow_remote, ssl_verify_file, ssl_verify_dir, validators_file, validation_seed, validator_token, validator_key_revocation, node_seed
Renders all list sections: sntp_servers, ips, ips_fixed, cluster_nodes, amendments, veto_amendments, rpc_startup
Renders all key-value sections: node_db, overlay, transaction_queue, voting, crawl, vl, reduce_relay, insight, perf, sqlite, import_db

userStories.title: Comprehensive validation
userStories.description: As a user, I want the validator to catch all misconfigurations with proper error/warning severity.
acceptanceCriteria: Replace packages/generator/src/validation.ts with new implementation using XrpldInput types
Export validateXrpldConfig(config: XrpldInput): ValidationResult
Port errors: numbers 1-65535, duplicate ports, no peer port, multiple peer ports, ws/wss mixed with http/https/peer
Port warnings: port 80/443, admin IP 0.0.0.0 or ::
Network errors: network_id valid (0-4294967295 or main/testnet/devnet), node_size one of tiny/small/medium/large/huge

Database errors: node_db.type NuDB/RocksDB, node_db.path required, online_delete >= 256, nudb_block_size power of 2 in 4096-32768, earliest_seq >= 1, ledger_history integer/full/none, ledger_history <= online_delete, database_path required, sqlite field constraints
Database warnings: RocksDB without online_delete, fetch_depth < 128, ledger_history > 10000000 with non-default sqlite

Protocol errors: ssl_verify 0/1, validation_seed + validator_token mutually exclusive, compression/signing_support true/false, peer_private/beta_rpc_api/ledger_replay 0/1, relay_proposals/relay_validations all/trusted/drop_untrusted, max_transactions 100-1000, workers/io_workers/prefetch_workers 1-1024, sweep_interval 10-600, overlay ranges, reduce_relay ranges, voting positive integers, crawl 0/1, path_search non-negative
Protocol warnings: signing_support=true, ssl_verify=0, no validator_token and no validation_seed, validator_list_sites not https
Peer warnings: peer_private=1 but no ips_fixed
Each ValidationEntry has section, field, value, message, severity
Typecheck passes
Unit tests for every error rule (at least one test per bullet)
Unit tests for every warning rule
userStories.notes: Depends on US-001 (types). This replaces the old validation.ts entirely. The generator from US-004 already calls this.

userStories.title: Text file parser with SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE mapping
